subject.title: Preserve aborted sessions across restart opt-in

question: Should OpenClaw accept `session.restartContinuation` as the opt-in contract for preserving aborted main-session IDs across controlled Gateway restarts, or should restart continuity use a broader config-free recovery design?
rationale: The code shape is plausible, but it creates a new session config and changes persisted session reuse semantics in an area the repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Close Until Sponsored
options.body: Close this contributor PR now and keep the canonical issue open until a maintainer sponsors this exact config contract or asks for a replacement design.

options.title: Sponsor The Opt-In
options.body: A maintainer can reopen or ask for a fresh PR if they accept `session.restartContinuation` as the intended narrow contract for this LCM restart-continuity case.

options.title: Require Config-Free Recovery
options.body: Reject the new knob and steer the remaining work toward a generic restart-recovery mechanism under the broader graceful-restart tracker.

recommendation.title: Close Until Sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this contributor PR now and keep the canonical issue open until a maintainer sponsors this exact config contract or asks for a replacement design.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the terminal-main transcript reconciliation behavior this PR changes and have adjacent session transcript history in the same path.
